name: Chicken Tagine with Apricot & Chickpea Cauliflower Rice

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 medium carrots
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root
1 ½ medium heads cauliflower

instructions.primary_message: Pat the chicken thighs dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season generously with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.36 kg chicken thighs, boneless skinless
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat. When the pot is hot add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Working in batches if necessary, add chicken to the pot and sear, flipping once, until golden brown on both sides, about 6 minutes. Once seared, remove chicken from the pot and set aside on a plate.
Meanwhile, peel and small dice the onion and carrots.
After removing the chicken, add onion and carrot to the pot and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 5 minutes.
Peel and mince the garlic and ginger.
Add garlic to the pot and cook for 30 seconds. Add ginger and spices and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp coriander
1 tbsp cumin
1 tbsp cinnamon
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Add broth and scrape any brown bits from the bottom of the pot. Return chicken to the pot, increase heat to high and bring liquid to a boil. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer until chicken is cooked through, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, cut the cauliflower heads into quarters, then trim off and discard the leaves. Using a box grater or food processor, coarsely grate the cauliflower and transfer to a large bowl.
Drain and rinse the chickpeas; set aside to drain further.
Using tongs, remove chicken from pot; transfer to a plate and loosely cover with foil.
Add cauliflower, chickpeas, almonds, and apricots to the pot. Increase the heat to medium-high and cook for 5 minutes.
Use a slotted spoon to dish the cauliflower mixture onto plates, leaving any excess liquid in the pot. Top with chicken and enjoy!
